headline: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August as a stronger dollar and bets on another Fed rate hike forced more than $1.3B of leveraged trades closed, with US producer prices due tonight.

market.asOf: Read about 03:51-03:59 UTC Fri 13 Nov (10:51-10:59 Bangkok; about 11pm ET Thursday) from CoinMarketCap's BTC and SOL pages; ETH from CoinMarketCap's ETH page at about 05:00 UTC. CoinGecko could not be opened this run. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 28, Fear (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index); CoinMarketCap's own index read 21 (Fear) at the same time.

stories.title: Bitcoin drops below $70,000 for the first time since August
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 early Friday in Asia and touched $69,000, its lowest level since 19 August, per CoinDesk. Ether fell below $2,000 for the first time since August. CoinDesk links the drop to a stronger US dollar, higher odds of a Fed rate hike in December, and renewed Middle East tension. Many traders had borrowed to bet on rising prices, and as prices fell, exchanges closed those bets automatically, which added to the selling.
points: More than $1.3B of leveraged bets were force-closed (liquidated) in 24 hours, $677M of them in bitcoin, per CoinGlass data cited by CoinDesk; CoinDesk's headline gives $1.2B.
About $500M was liquidated just as bitcoin crossed below $70,000, and the largest single liquidation was a long bitcoin bet of over $31M on Hyperliquid, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin is down 17% for the quarter, per CoinDesk.
The US Dollar Index traded above 103, its highest since April 2025, per CoinDesk.
Prices were read at about 11pm ET Thursday; use the live prices on this page for the current level.

stories.title: US producer prices tonight, with markets nearly sure of a December rate hike
stories.summary: The October producer price index (PPI), a measure of inflation at the wholesale level, comes out at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok). It follows a hot consumer inflation report earlier this week. Traders already expect the Fed to raise rates on 9 December. Higher rates make savings and bonds pay more, which tends to pull money away from risky assets like crypto.
points: Economists expect PPI to rise 0.4% on the month (prior +1.3%) and core PPI 0.3% (prior +0.7%), per the Goldman Sachs weekly calendar; Goldman itself expects +0.3% and +0.2%.
CME FedWatch on 12 Nov showed a 90.8% chance of a quarter-point hike and 9.2% for a half-point hike in December, per KuCoin.
The 10-year US Treasury yield was above 5%, per CoinDesk.
Cleveland Fed President Hammack prefers smaller, steadier hikes, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO exit and Strategy's removal from MSCI weigh on AI and bitcoin-company stocks
stories.summary: Nvidia said Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO and left its board, effective immediately, with CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO; Q3 results are still set for 17 November. Separately, index provider MSCI will remove Strategy (MSTR), the largest company holder of bitcoin, from its indexes after the 30 November close. CoinDesk says this could bring selling from funds that track those indexes.
points: Harvey C. Jones becomes Nvidia's board chair, per Nvidia's release filed with the SEC.
Nvidia shares fell as much as 14% at the open and closed down 4.3% on Thursday, per TheStreet.
Strategy holds 850,364 BTC, per the CoinDesk Daybook.
JPMorgan estimates up to $8.8B of forced selling of Strategy shares if other index providers follow MSCI, per TradingKey.

briefs.title: US moves to seize $1.2B stolen in the Binance hack
briefs.summary: A court approved seizing or holding more than $1.2B tied to October's Binance hack, part of more than $2.7B frozen so far; the Justice Department also took down "FaceStealer", a deepfake video-call scam linked to more than $400M of thefts, per The Block.

briefs.title: Crypto funds lose about $465M in a day
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $300M on Wednesday, about $270M of it from BlackRock's IBIT, and ether ETFs lost $145M, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Gemini's trading volume drops
briefs.summary: Gemini's Q3 revenue fell 19% to $40.9M and trading volume was $4.5B, while its net loss narrowed to $58.6M, per The Block.

briefs.title: Louisiana sues 10 prediction-market platforms
briefs.summary: Louisiana's Attorney General sued Kalshi, Robinhood, Polymarket, Crypto.com, Coinbase, Gemini and four others under state law and is seeking a restraining order, per The Block.

briefs.title: Kalshi warned of possible CFTC charges
briefs.summary: The CFTC reportedly warned Kalshi it could face charges over how it filed dozens of new contracts; Kalshi calls it a procedural error, per Blockhead.

briefs.title: Visa adds Western Union's stablecoin
briefs.summary: Visa can now settle payments using Western Union's USDPT stablecoin, issued by Anchorage Digital, and says its stablecoin settlement runs at $20B a year, per The Block.

briefs.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks fastest since 2022
briefs.summary: Stablecoin supply fell $14.2B in the 30 days to 9 November, the sharpest drop since June 2022, per Glassnode data reported by Blockonomi.
